challenge_012_diagnosis: Translation-only harbor passes 20 s, while chop wave-only survival improves from 5.26 s to 8.62 s with attempt 1; deck-relative drift remains uncontrolled because a stance residual cannot deliberately recenter
challenge_012_architecture_v2: Use the shipped frozen walk policy for a disclosed deck-relative recenter command, combined with a learned stance residual; train only on harbor and chop

challenge_012_reproducibility_audit: Re-evaluation showed chaotic fall timing is sensitive to seven-decimal gain rounding; candidate metrics must be computed after twelve-decimal serialization before future claims

challenge_012_attempt_6_diagnosis: All three chop runs exit the deck bounds without direct foot-floor contact: seeds 29 and 83 cross the lateral edge at 8.04 and 7.90 seconds, while seed 197 falls behind longitudinally at 6.18 seconds
next_step: For attempt 7, optimize axis-specific capture and command saturation against longitudinal lag and lateral roll drift while preserving all harbor gates; keep surge held out.
